authority: ODA DWG v5.4.1 section 20.4.44 specifies that plain R13/R14 DICTIONARY has no cloning field. The ODA R13-to-R14 producer pair below omits DXF group 281 in the selected root and group dictionaries.

localControl.before: both selected dictionaries explicitly write group 281 as 0
localControl.ezdxfReadback: ezdxf 1.4.5 reads both fields as absent and exposes its own default value 1

checks: The tracked R13 generated partial and R14 generated strict controls audit physical ASCII and Binary DXF root/group records and read the output back through a fresh adapter.
The source-presence marker survives copies and assignment, clears on reset or failed parse, and is compared to the immutable source baseline before source qualification.

The generated-source metadata controls exercise authored dictionaries across output versions and verify rollback and retry. The test's earlier three-entry expectation also failed on clean baseline 0f6f35863 for R2000+; it now verifies the fourth generated plot-style dictionary and its default edge.
limits: The selected producer comparison and local generated control do not prove native duplicate/clone semantics, complete graph closure, EED output, image-dictionary projection, or general strict AC1012 support.
The R13 control uses explicit partial output; the existing strict AC1012 refusal remains in force.
The new source-presence state changes DRW_Dictionary layout, so binary consumers must rebuild; no new pure virtual callbacks are introduced.
Generated drawings remain outside the repository.
